notes: Entry undetermined. The only non-vendor sources naming Visionaries are the June 2023 $52M round (unnamed; Index lead with Headline, Visionaries Club, Village Global: TechCrunch, tech.eu, Index's own post, BusinessCloud), which read as participation, not as 'existing investor'. But (a) GetHarley was already on the firm's portfolio page in the 2023-06-01 capture, 5 days before that announcement, (b) the firm's thesis text is in its early-portfolio style, and (c) Crunchbase (vendor, via a WebSearch summary) puts Visionaries Club in an ~$12M April 2021 Series A. Before June 2023 GetHarley had raised ~$15M over two rounds, the later a Series A of April 2021 (tech.eu; BeautyMatter). So the entry is most likely the April 2021 Series A (vendor-only) or else the June 2023 round; no press tie found for 2021 (Google News 'GetHarley' seed / Series A: nothing before 2023). Same gap as the Headline sibling (entry null). Status: site live; no later round, sale or shutdown found (Google News to 2025-08, WebSearch). Founded 2019 in London by Charmaine Chow (TechCrunch). Focus Healthcare & Bio matches Headline's row (telehealth).
